text:
ITEM 1 | Two wedge-shaped slices of flatbread-style pizza at upper right, golden-orange crust edge, glossy melted cheese with pale yellow sheen, two round red pepperoni-like discs with slightly curled edges and orange-red oil pooling, piece about 12 cm long and 5 cm wide per slice, sitting on the plate's upper-right rim | 180
ITEM 2 | Pile of thin julienned strands, pale cream to off-white with orange carrot shreds and bits of pale yellow strips, lightly glossy with oil, soft and slightly limp, spread loosely over about 15 cm by 10 cm on the left of the plate, roughly 2 cm tall | 120
ITEM 3 | Cubes of pale off-white firm block, about 2 cm per side, matte surface with some light green herb specks, slightly crumbly edges, scattered in a cluster about 8 cm by 6 cm in the center-right of the plate | 75
ITEM 4 | Round orange carrot slices and thick carrot coins, bright orange, glossy with slight oil sheen, some with browned edges and a small pale green herb garnish on one piece, arranged in a fan about 9 cm by 6 cm on the right of the plate, around 1.5 cm thick | 70
ITEM 5 | Long roasted carrot sticks, deep orange with darker caramelized edges and slightly wrinkled surface, about 8 cm long and 1.5 cm wide, lying diagonally near the bottom center of the plate | 50
ITEM 6 | Chunks of browned roasted vegetable, tan to golden brown with darker charred patches and slightly shiny surface, irregular pieces about 3 cm across, clustered at lower right of the plate, about 8 cm by 5 cm | 60
ITEM 7 | Small dark reddish-brown roasted pieces with a glossy, slightly wrinkled skin, about 2 cm across, one next to the carrot sticks near center, with small dark seed-like specks scattered among them | 15
ITEM 8 | Scattered small brown and tan granular specks, such as seeds or crumbs, dry and matte, dispersed sparsely across the plate surface and between other foods | 3
